description: This file implements a Krisp noise reduction audio filter for the Pipecat project, including a singleton manager for the Krisp processor, and a filter class that integrates with the base audio filter. It handles initialization, processing of audio frames, and noise reduction using Krisp's SDK.

classes.name: KrispProcessorManager
classes.description: Singleton manager for KrispAudioProcessor instances, ensuring only one instance exists throughout the program.

classes.name: KrispFilter
classes.description: Audio filter using Krisp noise reduction technology, providing real-time noise suppression for audio streams.

methods.name: get_processor(cls, sample_rate: int, sample_type: str, channels: int, model_path: str)
methods.description: Returns the singleton KrispAudioProcessor instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: None __init__( self, sample_type: str = "PCM_16", channels: int = 1, model_path: str = None )
methods.description: Initializes a KrispFilter, setting model path, sample type, channels, and other parameters.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initializes Krisp processor with transport's sample rate.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Applies Krisp noise reduction to a given audio frame.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes control frames to enable or disable filtering.
